Overview

Eger is a city in Heves with a population of 52,898. A beautiful Baroque city in northern Hungary, famous for its castle’s heroic defense against the Ottomans, the Valley of the Beautiful Women wine region, and thermal baths. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
